name: AI Study & Research Assistant
description: An experimental AI workflow designed to summarize academic papers, extract key computer science concepts, and generate structured review notes using Python and LLM prompt chaining.

caseStudy.overview: A personal exploration project to understand how Generative AI models can accelerate research and comprehension of complex CSIT curriculum topics.
caseStudy.problem: Reviewing dense academic papers and textbook chapters was time-consuming, with standard summarizers missing technical nuances in algorithms and architecture.
caseStudy.idea: Build a modular Python script that parses documents and passes them through guided prompt chains to yield structured notes, bullet summaries, and self-test quizzes.
caseStudy.approach: Broke down document analysis into three steps: document preprocessing, context-aware prompt templates, and structured JSON output formatting.
caseStudy.technologies: Python, OpenAI API / Gemini API, JSON parser, VS Code
features: Structured concept breakdown into core definitions and code examples
Key question generator for active recall
Export clean Markdown summaries for note-taking apps
caseStudy.result: Created a lightweight CLI utility that reduced reading review cycles while deepening my understanding of prompt structures and LLM context limits.
caseStudy.whatILearned: Learned how token limits impact output quality, how structured system prompts prevent hallucinations, and gained hands-on confidence with Python API integrations.

name: Automated Content & Alert Pipeline
description: An end-to-end automation workflow built in n8n that monitors tech releases, aggregates research updates, and routes customized digests to personal notification channels.

caseStudy.overview: An automation pipeline designed to eliminate repetitive manual tracking of emerging AI research papers, GitHub trending repositories, and tech updates.
caseStudy.problem: Checking multiple platforms daily created distraction and information overload without a unified summary.
caseStudy.idea: Leverage n8n's visual node ecosystem to fetch RSS feeds, filter relevant topics via custom logic, and dispatch daily digests.
caseStudy.approach: Designed a scheduled cron trigger that calls multiple data sources, normalizes payload schemas with JavaScript node functions, and posts structured updates.
caseStudy.technologies: n8n, Webhooks, REST APIs, JSON, Git
features: Automated RSS and API polling on a scheduled timer
Conditional filtering based on keyword relevance (AI, Python, LLMs)
Instant error alerting with retry mechanisms
caseStudy.result: Reliably runs automated workflows daily, providing a clean stream of learning materials with zero manual effort.
caseStudy.whatILearned: Deepened knowledge of HTTP request lifecycles, webhook security, JSON schema transformation, and error handling in automation architectures.

name: Core C & Python Algorithm Experiments
description: A collection of fundamental computer science implementations in C and Python, exploring memory management, sorting efficiency, and graph traversal.

caseStudy.overview: Hands-on laboratory repository built as part of BSc CSIT coursework and self-directed programming drills.
caseStudy.problem: Theoretical understanding of Big-O complexity and memory pointers needed deep practical coding reinforcement.
caseStudy.idea: Write clean, well-documented implementations from scratch in C for low-level understanding and Python for high-level scripting comparisons.
caseStudy.approach: Structured test benchmarks comparing execution time, recursive stack depths, and memory footprints between procedural C and Python.
features: Dynamic linked lists, stacks, and binary search trees in C with manual pointer management
Graph traversal algorithms (BFS, DFS, Dijkstra) in Python
Benchmarking scripts measuring real execution times
caseStudy.result: Solidified foundational computer science principles that underpin modern machine learning frameworks and high-performance software.
caseStudy.whatILearned: Mastered pointer arithmetic, memory allocation, asymptotic complexity analysis, and disciplined version control habits.

name: Personal AI Portfolio & Local Project Manager
description: A luxury-styled personal portfolio with a client-side project manager supporting local data editing and JSON export for a $0 GitHub Pages architecture.

caseStudy.overview: A production-grade, zero-cost personal platform presenting identity, learning roadmap, skills, and projects with luxury aesthetics.
caseStudy.problem: Needed a flexible portfolio where projects could be updated locally and deployed to GitHub Pages without expensive CMS or database services.
caseStudy.idea: Build a modular, component-driven client application with an integrated Portfolio Manager that exports clean JSON for git-based updates.
caseStudy.approach: Used a dark-first luxury design system with subtle bronze accents, data-driven project cards, and a modal-based case study viewer.
caseStudy.technologies: React, JavaScript, Tailwind, GitHub Actions, GitHub Pages
features: Data-driven project catalogue with multi-category filtering
Local Project Manager for adding/editing/exporting project data
Deep case-study reader modal for all project dimensions
Fully responsive, accessible, with zero external paid APIs
caseStudy.result: Created a high-impact, authentic digital identity that accurately communicates my learning journey and technical curiosities.
caseStudy.whatILearned: Learned state synchronization, client-side JSON serialization, responsive luxury UI principles, and automated CI/CD via GitHub Actions.
